criterionAssessments.rationale: Self-serve proxy and scraper-API dashboards are approachable for data engineers; product-line choice is the learning curve. Not a lab test.
Primary job is enterprise proxy / web-data collection — ranked with Bright Data, not Plesk or Datadog.
Residential/datacenter/mobile/ISP plus Web Unblocker and Web Scraper API cover a deep collection loop.
Python/Node/API SDKs and dashboard tooling for scraping stacks.
ISO 27001 certification and KYC/trust-center posture are buying reasons vs budget proxy vendors.
Corporate TB packs and enterprise commits scale; not unlimited free throughput.
Published $30 residential starter is clearer than Bright Data’s ~$499 commit floor — still premium GB pricing. Affiliate economics excluded.
OxyCopilot and scraper assist exist — scored as limited assistance, not a reason to skip proxy reliability.

overallScoreRationale: Weighted average of the eight IT editorial criteria using category weights (IT job fit 16, workflow depth 14, ease of use 12, integrations 12, admin/security 12, value 12, AI 12, scalability 10), rounded to 1 decimal. Products are scored inside their job cluster — ITSM, observability, source control, hosting panels, and web-data platforms are not forced into one undifferentiated ranking. Not a hands-on lab score, and affiliate economics are excluded.
